description: Actual gate-departure UTC minute equals scheduled gate-departure UTC minute plus signed departure delay modulo 1440.
rationale: Departure delay is defined as the signed difference between actual and scheduled gate-departure times, while both clock columns store minute-of-day values and therefore require modulo-1440 arithmetic across midnight.

description: Wheels-off UTC minute equals actual gate-departure UTC minute plus taxi-out duration modulo 1440.
rationale: TAXI_OUT is the elapsed time from gate departure to wheels off, so the two event clocks differ by that duration, including flights crossing midnight.

description: Wheels-on UTC minute equals wheels-off UTC minute plus airborne time modulo 1440.
rationale: AIR_TIME is explicitly the elapsed duration from takeoff to landing, so it determines the modulo-1440 clock displacement between the wheels-off and wheels-on events.

description: Actual gate-arrival UTC minute equals wheels-on UTC minute plus taxi-in duration modulo 1440.
rationale: TAXI_IN is the elapsed time from destination landing to gate arrival, so it fixes the modulo-1440 relationship between these two event clocks.

description: Scheduled arrival UTC minute equals scheduled departure UTC minute plus scheduled elapsed time modulo 1440.
rationale: CRS_ELAPSED_TIME is the scheduled gate-to-gate duration, so the scheduled origin and destination clock values must differ by that duration modulo the 24-hour clock.

description: Actual gate-arrival UTC minute equals actual gate-departure UTC minute plus actual elapsed time modulo 1440.
rationale: ELAPSED_TIME covers the complete actual gate-to-gate journey, so it determines the event-clock displacement even when the flight crosses midnight.

description: Actual gate-arrival UTC minute equals scheduled gate-arrival UTC minute plus signed arrival delay modulo 1440.
rationale: ARR_DELAY is the signed difference between actual and scheduled destination gate-arrival times, while both event columns are minute-of-day clocks; modulo-1440 arithmetic handles flights whose arrival clock crosses midnight.
